description: A shell script named size_compare.sh that compares the sizes of OpenWrt packages against upstream data, including configuration diffing and package size analysis.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Displays help message extracted from script comments.

methods.name: package_size
methods.description: Determines the size of a package, either installed or uninstalled, from a given index file.

methods.name: compare_sizes
methods.description: Compares local and upstream package sizes, outputs differences, and totals.
